captions: A customer spent just enough for free delivery, and the farm charged her anyway.
Lorcan's tests only use ordinary orders, so they pass while the line is wrong.
You test right on the edges: the line, an empty Friday, first and last, a full van.
Now a mistake at any edge fails a test before the van leaves.
Same rules, same van. The awkward cases are covered too.
